name: Ways of Seeing: Duerckheim X Serralves
description: Explore a dialogue between two major collections, revealing new connections and perspectives on contemporary art.
longDescription:
"Ways of Seeing: Duerckheim X Serralves" is an art exhibition presented by the Serralves Foundation, exploring a curatorial dialogue between two significant collections. This unique presentation aims to uncover new relationships and interpretations within contemporary art by juxtaposing works from the Duerckheim Collection with pieces from Serralves' own holdings. The exhibition provides an opportunity to observe how different institutional and private collecting philosophies can illuminate shared themes and divergent perspectives in artistic practice.

Visitors to the Serralves Foundation during this period will encounter a carefully curated display designed to foster contemplation and discovery. The exhibition is housed within the grand setting of the Serralves Museum of Contemporary Art, known for its expansive galleries and integration with the surrounding park. The experience is intended for art enthusiasts, researchers, and general visitors interested in contemporary art and curatorial practice.

The exhibition runs from June 18 to June 24, 2026. Serralves Foundation is accessible by bus lines 201, 203, 207, 502, and 504, with stops directly outside the venue. Tickets are available for purchase at the Serralves Foundation or online.
